name: @phoenix/synckit
description: The shared sync layer of webOS Phoenix's Synergy transports (docs/SYNERGY-MODERN.md 4.2): Luna and db8 helpers, sync state records, scheduling, an HTTP client with host allow-list and Retry-After backoff, item records with three-way merge, the contacts linker's rules and the vCard / iCalendar mappers. Plain CommonJS without dependencies: runs on a device (run-js-service), in the simulator and in tests
